results.sql:
WITH order_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        l_orderkey,
        AVG(l_extendedprice) AS order_avg_extendedprice
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT 
    l_orderkey,
    l_linenumber,
    l_extendedprice,
    order_avg_extendedprice
FROM lineitem
JOIN order_avg ON lineitem.l_orderkey = order_avg.l_orderkey
WHERE 
    l_shipmode = 'AIR' 
    AND l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' 
    AND l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31' 
    AND l_extendedprice > order_avg.order_avg_extendedprice
ORDER BY 
    l_orderkey ASC, 
    l_linenumber ASC

    SELECT
        o.o_orderkey,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey

SELECT

        WHEN net_revenue >= 50000 AND net_revenue < 100000 THEN '03_50-100k'

FROM order_revenues

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_custkey,
        c.c_name,
        n.n_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_net_spending
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
        AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        n_name,
        c_name,
        ROUND(total_net_spending, 2) AS total_net_spending,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY n_name 
            ORDER BY total_net_spending DESC, c_name ASC
        ) AS spending_rank
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT 
    n_name,
    c_name,
    total_net_spending,
    spending_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE spending_rank <= 3
ORDER BY n_name ASC, spending_rank ASC
